vehicleUpdates.generation: KA4 original body, MY21–23; excludes KA4 PE / MY25 facelift

length.basis: Original Australian MY22 manufacturer sheet; corrects the previous 5,115-mm older-generation figure.

observedConsumption.basis: CarExpert exact 2021 S diesel: trip-computer result over 643 km mixed driving, including a return Torquay trip. Separately, CarsGuide recorded 7.5 over a family week. Neither is a controlled population average.

vehicleUpdates.summary: Eight seats and five anchored restraint positions offer more layout choices. A related SLi test included rear-facing row two and forward-facing row three. Check your seats; frequent short trips can trigger the diesel severe-service schedule.

safety.applicability: Original Australian S diesel covered by the 2021 rating, expiring December 2027. All-row curtain airbags; front-centre airbag arrived with February 2024 facelift builds, excluded here. A 2024 registration alone does not establish the facelift.

vehicleUpdates.servicing: Normal: 12 months / 15,000 km. Severe use: oil/filter 6 months / 7,500 km; assess short-trip school-run use against the handbook.

familyFit.summary: Related original SLi/Platinum tests show five restraints over two rear rows, including a mixed-facing layout. Exact S seats and your three-restraint combination remain unconfirmed.
familyFit.row2: Three independently sliding seats, each with ISOFIX and top tether. Only use restraints with vehicle seats facing forwards.
familyFit.row3: Both outboard seats have ISOFIX and top tether. Centre has neither; ANCAP does not recommend a restraint there.
familyFit.testedSeats: BabyDrive reports five restraints over rows two/three and a rear-facing row-two seat ahead of a forward-facing row-three seat, with a 182-cm driver. Product names are not published; rear-facing installations needed tether extension straps.
familyFit.buckleAccess: No independent mixed-three booster-buckling trial was verified. ANCAP found one rear-facing convertible incompatible with outboard ISOFIX in both rows and required care with one forward-facing model in row three.
familyFit.access: Removing the middle second-row seat creates a walkway. S has manual sliding doors. Its CarsGuide test found the outer-seat walk-in lever awkward with a restraint fitted; never move an occupied seat. Recheck installation after any adjustment.
familyFit.ventilation: MY22 S has manual front/rear air conditioning, controls at row two and vents in both rear rows. Higher-trim climate control and powered-door observations do not transfer to S.

cons: Diesel short-trip use can require more frequent servicing and hinder DPF regeneration.
S has manual doors and air conditioning; exact booster access needs a fit trial.
inspection: Fit one rear-facing plus your other two seats, check permitted tether extensions, buckle reach and third-row access.
Ask whether driving history required 6-month / 7,500-km oil changes; check invoices, DPF warning/fault history and diesel fuel-filter services.
Verify first delivery, rental/rideshare history, remaining warranty and completed VIN recalls.
Check the 120,000-km diesel timing-belt inspection, all-row air conditioning, seat locks, manual-door latches and head-unit operation.

changes.period: MY21–23 original KA4; 2021–24 advertised build/registration years
changes.text: This entry covers original S 2.2 diesel eight-seat cars. Confirm build, model year and body: a 2024 advertisement can instead be the materially changed MY25 facelift.
ANCAP records the front-centre airbag from this facelift boundary. Do not apply later equipment or 2025 cluster recalls to every original S.

gaps: BabyDrive used related SLi/Platinum trims and did not identify restraint product names. Exact mixed-three booster access is unverified.
The manufacturer labels third-row folded luggage as 2,785 L VDA and 2,461 L SAE; keep standards distinct.
No representative Australian KA4 diesel annual paid-repair average or exact installed engine/gearbox/DPF quote was found.
Owner aggregate mixes original/facelift, petrol/diesel and a professional borrowed-car review.

ownershipUpdates.serviceInterval: Normal: 12 months / 15,000 km. Severe use: oil/filter 6 months / 7,500 km; assess short-trip school-run use against the handbook.
ownershipUpdates.serviceBasis: A$600/year remains an analyst long-ownership provision. Verified Kia normal-schedule seven-visit totals: MY21/22 A$3,767 (~A$538/year), MY23 A$3,816 (~A$545/year). These do not price extra severe-use oil changes or work after 105,000 km; get a VIN quote for school-run use.
warrantyCautions: Original 7-year private-use unlimited-kilometre coverage transfers; confirm first delivery and the vehicle’s own warranty document. Any commercial/rental/rideshare use can impose the 150,000-km limit.
Current terms distinguish the 2-year original 12V battery, 3-year audio head unit and wear/particulate-filter exclusions. Do not assume every component lasts under the full seven-year cover.
Keep detailed service invoices and assess the Australian severe-use schedule. A warranty repair or recall is separate from paid wear, misuse or maintenance.

risks.title: DPF trouble: diagnosis before replacement
risks.detail: Australian handbook explains that repeated short/slow trips can prevent regeneration and prolonged warnings can cause damage/oil dilution. A Brisbane recycler lists a KA4 2.2 diesel DPF at A$660, parts only. A fitted new DPF or cleaning quote was not verified; the old broad A$3,000–7,000 Kia proxy is removed.
risks.priceBasis: A$660 is one used-part advertisement, not a complete repair cost or a guaranteed suitable part. Diagnosis, removal, cleaning or new replacement, freight, labour and GST treatment require a written local quote.
risks.warranty: Current Kia terms exclude particulate-filter limited-life items and maintenance; ask Kia to assess any diagnosed manufacturing defect under the original terms and statutory rights.

risks.title: Engine or automatic gearbox: major-cost exposure
risks.detail: A Brisbane recycler advertises a KA4 D4HE diesel engine at A$7,250 and matching eight-speed automatic at A$2,500, parts only. These illustrate major-failure exposure; they do not show that either part commonly fails. Check exact donor compatibility and condition.
risks.priceBasis: Used components only. Installed totals, consumables, diagnostics, freight and GST treatment unverified; no failure probability or new-component quote available.
risks.warranty: Manufacturing defects may qualify for the remaining original warranty; usage, service history, wear and cause must be assessed. Applicable recall remedies are free.

risks.title: VIN-specific recalls; avoid V6/power-door contamination
risks.detail: Recheck selected 2021 fuel-pipe REC-001615 and right-door-latch REC-005019 completion. REC-005685 addresses power sliding doors, whereas original S doors are manual. The June 2026 3.5-litre V6 fuel-pipe REC-006644 and selected 2025 cluster REC-006557 are not generic diesel S repair risks.
risks.priceBasis: Applicable official recall work is free; exact VIN and equipment determine applicability.
risks.warranty: Ask Kia for written VIN recall status, including campaigns after purchase; ordinary warranty expiry does not turn an applicable recall into a default paid repair.

fuelEstimate.basis: L/100km diesel planning scenario: 8 point, 6.5–10 sensitivity bounds. Rated combined 6.5 remains separate; exact S tests recorded 7.2 indicated over 643 km (CarExpert) and 7.5 over a family week (CarsGuide). The 8 point allows for local use/load/regeneration and is an assumption, not a measured annual average.

reviewUpdates.scope: ProductReview KA4 aggregate: mixed original/facelift, petrol/diesel and trims; includes a professional borrowed-car review. Limited relevance to original S diesel.
reviewUpdates.summary: 18 self-selected contributions, not a reliability survey. Owners often praise space and diesel economy; some describe electronic/horn faults and delays obtaining parts or a suitable loan car. Later GT-Line complaints do not establish original S behaviour.
positiveThemes: Flexible passenger space and occupied-row boot.
Diesel economy and comfort praised in several contributions.
negativeThemes: Some report electronics, horn or head-unit problems.
Some report warranty delays and unsuitable/unavailable loan cars; anecdotal, not a failure rate.

expertReviews.tested: 2021 Australian Carnival S 2.2 diesel, family week
expertReviews.scope: Exact original S diesel; test result and period equipment, not a used-car reliability score.
expertReviews.verdict: Spacious family transport; base-trim seat comfort, walk-in lever and driver-assist alerts drew criticism.
negativeThemes: Walk-in lever awkward with child seat installed.
Seat comfort over long trips and touchy lane warnings.

expertReviews.scope: Exact original S diesel provided by Kia Australia; professional review, separate from owner aggregate.
expertReviews.verdict: Strong family practicality and warranty; basic steering-wheel finish.
positiveThemes: Practical seating, deep occupied-row boot and warranty.

insuranceUpdates.basis: Rounded planning proxy from Youi national mixed-year/model comprehensive mean A$1,584, policies sold 22 November 2025–22 May 2026. Not an exact trim/year or Queensland household quote. The published 80%-within-or-below band is not a confidence interval; displayed wider scenarios are analyst budgets. Replace with a personal quote.

tyreUpdates.basis: Four Michelin Primacy 5 235/65R17 108V XL at A$329 each = A$1,316. JAX includes fitting, balancing, valves, waste handling and GST; alignment extra. Original base/S brochures specify 235/65R17. Confirm placard, wheel size, load/speed index and local stock. Set bounds and tyre life are assumptions, not measured model averages.

repairReserveUpdates.basis: A$1,300/year analyst repair savings fund retained; no representative Australian KA4 diesel paid-repair average was found. DPF use/maintenance, turbo-diesel components and major powertrain costs justify a wide sensitivity range, but do not establish annual failure rates. Used engine A$7,250 and gearbox A$2,500 are parts-only examples, not annual bills. Excludes scheduled service, tyres and insured collisions; claim applicable warranty/recalls first.

fitAssessments.summary: Original SLi/Platinum practical tests establish useful mixed-facing, multirow options, not certification of the base S with your exact seats.

arrangement.detail: BabyDrive reports five installed restraints over rows two/three and a rear-facing row-two seat ahead of a forward-facing row-three seat. Product names and full facing mix are unstated; your one rear-facing plus two other seats must be checked, including any approved tether extensions.

buckles.detail: No independent daily booster-buckling test for the target three-seat S layout was verified. A spacious cabin does not establish buckle reach.

space.detail: Related SLi trial accommodated a 182-cm driver ahead of rear-facing row two and forward-facing row three, with good legroom. Exact restraint model and driver proportions still matter.

access.detail: Sliding doors and a removable centre row-two seat provide a walkway. Exact S test found the walk-in lever awkward with a restraint; doors are manual. Handbook prohibits adjusting an occupied second-row seat; use a checked layout and reinstall/recheck if moved.

audit.summary: Stronger mixed-facing, multirow fit evidence; corrected old-generation length; four current VIN-deduplicated asks; explicit diesel severe servicing; scoped owner reviews and parts-only repair evidence.

items.finding: Four distinct current 2021–23 QLD S diesel cars: A$32,886–39,750 drive-away, median A$38,189.50, 63,453–112,238 km. Direct sellers override stale cross-posts; sold and facelift stock excluded. Thin asking sample, no realised-sale data.

Original 2.2 diesel, 148 kW/440 Nm, FWD eight-speed torque-converter automatic; no traction battery or plug. Rated 6.5 L/100km kept separate from observed 7.2/7.5; family budget 8 remains an assumption. No V6/HEV or facelift test substitution.

Related tests show five restraints, rear-facing legroom and multirow choices. Three row-two and two row-three outboard tether/ISOFIX positions; no centre row-three restraint. Exact S booster access is a gap. Length corrected to 5,155 mm; boot standards retained separately.

Original private-use 7 years/unlimited km is transferable, subject to terms; commercial history can impose 150,000 km. Current terms list shorter 12V/audio coverage and maintenance/particulate-filter exclusions. Verify first delivery and original contract; no blanket seven-year component promise.

Normal seven-visit totals verified: MY21/22 A$3,767, MY23 A$3,816; A$600 annual provision retained. Australian manual adds 7,500-km/6-month severe-use oil changes, 24-month brake fluid, diesel belt inspection 120,000 km and system replacement 240,000 km; high-mileage/severe-use quote needed.

A$1,580 annual budget retained against Youi A$1,584 national mixed-year Carnival mean for policies sold 22 Nov 2025–22 May 2026. Published A$1,073–1,908 band covers 80% within or below, not an interval for this QLD household; personal quote required.

S 235/65R17 verified; JAX Primacy 5 108V XL A$329 each fitted/GST included, A$1,316 set retained. At assumed 40,000-km life, A$493.50/year at 15,000 km. Life and price bounds are assumptions; confirm placard, alignment and local stock.

A$1,300 annual savings fund retained, not an observed repair average. Replaced generic fitted DPF range with exact KA4 used-part evidence and unknown installed totals. VIN-specific free recalls separated from V6, power-door and 2025-only campaigns; no AU failure-rate dataset found.

Added KA4 ProductReview 3.1/5 from 18 mixed-engine/facelift contributions, including a borrowed-car professional review; limit scoring relevance. Exact S diesel professional tests: CarsGuide 7.0/10 and Exhaust Notes 7.8/10; CarExpert retains its current qualitative verdict.

S diesel is four-cylinder: current private QLD registration/traffic/CTP A$864.50–880.50. Conventional duty is A$3 per A$100 up to A$100,000, not hybrid rates. Braked towing 2,000 kg/200-kg ball; observe payload. All-row curtains and 2021 ANCAP apply; facelift centre airbag not inherited.
